object_description: elongated two-story bar with escape balconies
design_condition: The elongated bar runs parallel to the road, leaves space for the existing buildings, and acts as a shield around a protected courtyard, although a more precise urban-planning setting is desirable.

positive.statement: The project intends to create a clear address and urban development for the existing complex.
The formally clear and concise structural concept leaves the interiors practically column-free.
The project has great floor-plan potential and good space and volume efficiency.
It promotes open forms of learning and can respond to educational requirements and concepts.
The lowered auditorium creates interesting spatial and visual references and enables a two-story appearance.
The careful use of floor space and building volume produces an economically optimized building.

negative.statement: The building is too narrow for the specified spatial program, especially in the access zones, and produces partly impractical room configurations.
An even more precise urban-planning setting would be desirable.
The peripheral placement of the bicycle parking spaces is unfavorable for sustainability reasons.
The proposed car-parking arrangement on the neighboring plot cannot be implemented in this way.
The facades and the prominent escape systems are not convincingly conceived or integrated.
Implementation of the spatial concept requires a general revision, including a reconsideration of the overall dimensions.
